scope: Research only: current positioning, existing assets and resources, brand relationships, messaging gaps. No new artwork, uploads, purchases, transactions, wallet connection, or demo submissions.
method_limits: Live urllib HTTPS requests are the primary current evidence. Search/crawler results were useful for discovery but sometimes stale: crawler showed an obsolete 12-PSC list and a missing ecosystem route; live requests showed 13 PSCs and HTTP200 ecosystem content.
HTTP200 and accessible copy establish page/resource availability, not correct smart-contract operation, security, commercial readiness, or truth of universal superlatives.

HOST/demo routes initially return client-rendered shells. A headless Chromium hydration check was attempted but blocked by this environment's proxy certificate trust (ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID). TLS verification was not disabled. These routes are therefore not labeled broken.

MCP endpoint/configuration show Loading in the initial developer HTML; runtime population was not verified. Network dashboard contains client-side template values in initial HTML; its live metrics were not verified.
